evidence: start: Incident Report, Summary - degradation or unavailability of several products in the Tokyo region began 04:20 Pacific on 7 Sep 2024. | end: Incident Report, Summary and Remediation - impact lasted 1h50m; manual failover to healthy zones fully mitigated it at 06:10 Pacific. | regions: Incident Report, Root Cause - all instance operations in asia-northeast1 were disrupted; a zonal replica failed but no zone is named.
notes: Published date is the Incident Report entry (13 Sep 2024 06:44 PDT = 13:44Z). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). Six products named: Compute Engine, Cloud Build, Dataflow, Cloud Deploy, Cloud SQL, GKE. Root cause mentions a zonal replica of a metadata store and two other healthy zones, but no zone code is named, so zones is empty. 06:10 is both the stated mitigation time and the Incident End; the stated 1h50m impact window from 04:20 supports impact_ended.

evidence: start: Incident Report, Summary - BigQuery customers saw elevated query latency in the us and eu multi-regions from 30 May 2024. | end: Incident Report, Summary - the latency period lasted until 23:45 Pacific on 13 Jun 2024. | regions: Mini Incident Report, Customer Impact - logging ingestion via us-central1 or us-central2 was delayed; BigQuery impact was in multi-regions.
notes: Published date is the Incident Report entry (26 Jun 2024 15:08 PDT = 22:08Z). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). The Incident Report gives only the date for the start of latency impact (30 May 2024), so start_utc is the start of that US/Pacific day in UTC with day precision. The page header and Mini Incident Report cover a sub-incident of elevated API errors in the us multi-region from 16:46 to 20:00 Pacific on 10 Jun 2024 (2024-06-10T23:46Z to 2024-06-11T03:00Z; header shows 18:07 to 20:09); the full latency event is coded here because rule 6 takes the first stated customer impact. Root cause fully mitigated at 21:00 Pacific on 13 Jun. Multi-region locations us and eu are named but add no code; the regions are those given for Cloud Logging ingestion. Services: BigQuery and Cloud Logging.
